input.summary: Insert new Section 10.3 requiring transition assistance, Customer Data return and certified deletion on expiry or termination.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 winds down access and Deliverables but says nothing about exit support or getting our data back, so we have added a transition-assistance and data-return provision: up to six months' assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is an issue we can accept ninety days of assistance, provided the thirty-day export and deletion certification remain.

ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty days of Customer's request, return or make available for download all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.
